sv.title: Riksbankens it-chef arbetsbefrias efter Ekots granskning
sv.summary: Riksbankens it-chef Mats Eklund har arbetsbefriats tills vidare, dock som längst till årsskiftet, skriver myndigheten i ett pressmeddelande. Orsaken är att det inletts en internutredning efter Ekots rapportering om hans resor till Jaåan och Kanada.

en.title: The Riksbank's IT chief relieved of duties after Ekot investigation
en.summary: The Riksbank's IT chief Mats Eklund has been relieved of duties until further notice, but for no longer than until the turn of the year, the authority says in a press release. The reason is that an internal investigation has been launched following Ekot's reporting on his trips to Jaåan and Kanada.
